value.title: Explore Norway: Guided Adventures with Baryonyx Tours
value.description: Embark on unforgettable adventures with Baryonyx in Norge. Experience guided trips that connect you with nature. Discover breathtaking landscapes today!
value.main_text_excerpt:
The Baryonyx Equipment List Is Now Available
Our complete equipment list is now available on the Equipment page.
At Baryonyx, every component is selected exclusively on the basis of quality, precision, reliability, and performance under demanding Norwegian hunting conditions.
Our equipment setup is the result of extensive testing, practical field experience, and continuous evaluation. We have studied how each component performs together in real hunting situations and selected the combination that consistently delivers the best overall results.
Depending on the guest’s preference, the type of hunt, and the conditions, our clients may choose between the Blaser R8 and the Blaser K95. The rifles are fitted with suppressors from Svemko and paired with ammunition from THAC Bullets.
This complete setup has been developed to provide exceptional precision, low weight, reduced recoil, reliable terminal performance, and consistent results in the field. During long days in the mountains and rapidly changing weather conditions, every component must perform exactly as intended.
Baryonyx does not select equipment based on what is cheapest. We select what works. Every rifle, suppressor, cartridge, and piece of equipment has been chosen because it contributes to the strongest possible overall hunting system.
The Equipment page is published solely to provide our clients with clear information about the equipment available during their hunts. The products and brands listed are not sponsored, and no company has paid for inclusion. They are featured because they meet the standards of quality and performance demanded by Baryonyx.
View the complete equipment list on our Equipment page.
Baryonyx x Blaser Jagdreisen
In the timeless pursuit of excellence, Baryonyx has entered into an official partnership with Blaser Jagdreisen, one of Europe’s most distinguished hunting outfitters.
Together we unite a shared philosophy of uncompromising craftsmanship, respect for nature, and the pursuit of truly authentic hunting experiences.
From the serene forests and mountains of Innlandet to the vast wilderness of Finnmark, this collaboration marks a new chapter where tradition meets precision and the spirit of adventure remains untouched.
Welcome to the Baryonyx Way.

What types of adventures does Baryonyx offer?
Baryonyx crafts bespoke wilderness experiences — from elite big-game hunts and Arctic fishing to silent aurora nights and alpine hikes. Each journey is built for those who seek the rare, the raw, and the real.
Are the guides experienced in handling challenging conditions?
Yes — and far beyond. All Baryonyx guides are highly trained professionals with deep field experience in remote Nordic terrain. They are certified in advanced first aid, risk management, and group safety under extreme conditions.
We operate under a strict ethical code, prioritizing responsible hunting, wildlife conservation, and guest wellbeing. Discretion, professionalism, and preparedness are not extras — they are our standard.
What should I bring on a Baryonyx adventure trip?
We provide curated packing lists tailored to your chosen experience. In general: quality outdoor clothing, robust footwear, and a readiness for true adventure. Specific gear requirements — including any specialty equipment — will be outlined by your guide team.
How can I book a trip with Baryonyx?
Booking is personal and seamless. Select your preferred experience on our website or reach out directly for a tailored itinerary. From first contact to final destination, we handle every detail discreetly and professionally.
Get in Touch Today
Contact Baryonyx in Norge for unforgettable guided adventure trips.
Or call us: +47 916 744 31

pages.title: Discover Norway: Guided Adventures with Baryonyx Tours
pages.main_text_excerpt:
About us
Baryonyx was founded with one purpose: to offer authentic, world-class hunting and nature experiences in the most remote parts of Norway — for those who demand more than a tour.
We work with the land, not around it. Our guides are professionals with decades of field experience. Our guests are leaders, doers, and thinkers who seek solitude, precision, and meaning.
Each expedition is built on three principles:
Discretion. Quality. Integrity.
No crowds. No compromise. Just the pursuit — pure and personal.
Our mission
To preserve and elevate the Nordic hunting and wilderness tradition by offering rare, curated experiences built on respect:
For nature. For the craft. For our guests.
Introducing Norway’s Top Adventure Experts
Magne Knackstedt
Senior guide, Pilot and Group Coordinator
Phone: +47 99164372
Ludvig Leopold Baksjøberget
Senior guide, Pilot and Group Coordinator
Phone: +47 91674431
Henri Knackstedt
Senior guide
Odin Odinsen
Guide and HSE Manager (Health, Safety, and Environment Manager)
Tobias Eriksen
Guide
Håvard Ruud
Guide
Siril Malene Bentsen
Reservations Agent, Customer Service Representative
Ulrik Leinan
Legal Advisor, In-house Counsel
The Baryonyx Rig
The Arctic Convoy
From luxury vans to rugged Arctic 4x4s, our convoy ensures comfort and capability on every road. Whether it’s airport transfers or remote wilderness tracks, we take you there in style.
The Arctic Wings
From rugged seaplanes to private premium aircraft, our Arctic Wings give you unmatched flexibility. Whether you want to soar over fjords or arrive in ultimate style, we provide the perfect flight experience tailored to your adventure.
The Arctic Igloos
Step into a world of refined wilderness luxury. Our state-of-the-art Arctic igloos combine the raw beauty of Norway’s landscapes with world-class comfort. Each igloo is designed for premium stargazing and aurora viewing, while offering cozy interiors, modern amenities, and a touch of exclusivity you won’t find anywhere else. Whether you’re here for adventure or relaxation, the igloos provide the perfect blend of high-end comfort and wild Arctic atmosphere.
The Arctic Arsenal & Angler’s Collection
Our collection of world-class rifles, shotguns, and fishing gear is nothing less than high-end excellence. From precision-crafted firearms to premium rods and reels, every piece is selected to meet the highest standards. Whether it’s reindeer hunting in the rugged highlands, capercaillie in the deep forests, or salmon and Arctic char fishing in pristine rivers and lakes — Baryonyx equips you with only the very best, ensuring your adventure is as extraordinary as the wilderness itself.
Our guides are more than experts — they are professionals shaped by a lifetime in the Nordic wilderness.
With backgrounds in hunting, tracking, survival and fieldcraft, they lead with calm confidence, ethical clarity and unmatched local knowledge.
They don’t follow the trail. They know it by heart.
Unforgettable Norwegian Expeditions
Join our expert-led adventures to explore Norway's majestic landscapes. With personalized itineraries, experience the thrill of nature like never before.
